text: What review frequency does DORA require for a bank's ICT risk management framework, and which events should trigger an ad hoc review outside the regular review cycle?
How often do we have to review how our bank handles IT risks under DORA, and what kinds of events mean we need an extra review in between the regular ones?

Estoy preparando el calendario de revisiones del marco de riesgo TIC del banco: ¿cada cuánto pide DORA que se revise y qué tiene que pasar para que toque hacer una revisión extra fuera de ese calendario?

When renegotiating our contract with the ICT third-party service provider that operates our core banking platform, under what circumstances must we be able to terminate it, and what must be in place, both in the contractual terms and in our own exit planning, so that we can migrate the service to another provider or bring it back in-house without disruption to our customers?

We're renegotiating the contract with the company that runs our main banking system. In what situations do we need to be able to get out of the contract, and what do we need to have in place, both in the contract and in our own plans, so we can switch to another company or run it ourselves without causing problems for our customers?

Estamos renegociando el contrato con el proveedor que nos gestiona el core bancario: ¿en qué casos tenemos que poder rescindirlo, y qué tiene que recoger el contrato y qué tenemos que tener previsto por nuestra parte para poder cambiarnos a otro proveedor o internalizarlo sin que los clientes se vean afectados?

Our firm operates as a small payment institution under our Member State's exemption rather than holding full payment institution authorisation, and we had assumed the exemption also places us outside the scope of DORA. Does DORA apply to an exempt small payment institution such as ours, and if so, are we required to implement the same ICT risk management framework as larger institutions, or does a lighter regime apply?

I run a small payments business that uses my country's exemption for small payment firms, so we don't have a full licence, and I assumed being exempt also means DORA doesn't apply to us. Does DORA cover us or not, and if it does, do we have to put in place the same IT risk management setup as the big players or is there a lighter version for a business our size?

Tengo una empresa de pagos pequeña acogida a la exención para pequeñas entidades de pago de nuestro país, así que no tenemos licencia completa, y daba por hecho que por estar exentos DORA no nos afecta. ¿Nos aplica DORA o no? Y si nos aplica, ¿tenemos que montar la misma gestión de riesgos TIC que las entidades grandes o hay una versión más ligera para empresas de nuestro tamaño?

What administrative sanctions and remedial measures can the national competent authority impose on an insurance undertaking for non-compliance with DORA, can individual members of the management body be held personally liable, and what is the maximum administrative fine the undertaking could face?

If our insurance company doesn't fully meet the DORA rules, what can our country's regulator do to us in terms of penalties or making us fix things, can individual board members get in trouble personally, and what's the biggest fine we could be hit with?

Si nuestra aseguradora no cumple con DORA, ¿qué sanciones nos puede poner el supervisor, qué nos puede obligar a corregir, pueden los consejeros responder a título personal y cuál es la multa máxima que nos podría caer?

How frequently is a crypto-asset service provider that holds clients' crypto-assets in custody required to provide each client with a statement of the crypto-assets it holds for that client, and are clients entitled to request such a statement between the periodic ones?

We run a crypto exchange that keeps our customers' tokens for them. How often do we have to send each customer a statement of the crypto we're holding for them, and can customers also ask us for one in between?

Trabajo en un exchange de criptomonedas que custodia los tokens de sus clientes. ¿Cada cuánto tenemos que enviar a cada cliente un extracto de los criptoactivos que le guardamos, y puede el cliente pedirnos uno entre medias?

Can a Singapore-based crypto exchange with no MiCA authorisation continue serving clients in Germany who were onboarded on a reverse solicitation basis, without having to obtain an EU authorisation, and may it email those clients about the new tokens and services it is about to launch?

Our crypto exchange is based in Singapore and has no EU license. Some people in Germany found us by themselves and signed up. Can we keep serving them without getting licensed in the EU, and can we email them about the new tokens and services we're about to launch?

Nuestro exchange de cripto está en Singapur y no tiene licencia MiCA, pero se nos han registrado clientes en Alemania que nos encontraron por su cuenta. ¿Podemos seguir dándoles servicio sin tener que pedir licencia en la UE? ¿Y podemos mandarles correos anunciando los tokens y servicios nuevos que vamos a lanzar?

As a crypto-asset service provider authorised under MiCA, what originator and beneficiary information must we transmit with each outgoing crypto-asset transfer, both to other CASPs and to customers' self-hosted wallets, and what additional checks are required when the transfer goes to a self-hosted wallet?

We run a crypto exchange licensed in the EU and are setting up withdrawals to other exchanges and to customers' own personal wallets. What details about the sender and the receiver have to be sent along with every crypto transfer, and what extra checks do we need to do when the coins go to a customer's own wallet rather than to another exchange?

Llevo cumplimiento en un exchange de cripto con licencia MiCA y estamos preparando los envíos a otros exchanges y a wallets de autocustodia de los clientes: ¿qué datos de quien envía y de quien recibe tienen que ir con cada transferencia, y qué comprobaciones extra hay que hacer cuando el destino es una wallet de autocustodia?

We are a mid-sized crypto exchange authorised as a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA and are drafting our business continuity policy: what must the policy be designed to achieve under MiCA, which ICT continuity and recovery plans must it incorporate, and at what frequency must those plans be tested?

We're a mid-sized crypto exchange with a MiCA licence and we're writing our policy for keeping the business running if something goes wrong. What does that policy have to achieve under the crypto rules, what plans does it need to include for keeping our IT running and getting it back up if it goes down, and how often do we have to test those plans?

Somos un exchange de criptomonedas de tamaño medio con licencia MiCA y estamos redactando nuestra política de continuidad de negocio. ¿Qué tiene que conseguir esa política según MiCA, qué planes de continuidad y de recuperación de sistemas tiene que incluir y cada cuánto hay que probarlos?
Within what timeframe must a payment service provider respond to a consumer complaint about a duplicate card transaction, and in which circumstances may that timeframe be extended?
My card was charged twice for the same purchase and I complained to my bank. How long do they have to answer me, and when are they allowed to take longer?
Me han cobrado dos veces el mismo pago con tarjeta y he puesto una reclamación al banco, ¿cuánto tiempo tienen para contestarme y en qué casos pueden tardar más?

A consumer identified, approximately six weeks after the debit, that the monthly direct debit collected by her gym was significantly higher than usual. Notwithstanding that she signed the direct debit mandate, can she claim a refund from her payment service provider, what is the deadline for submitting the refund request, and within what timeframe is the payment service provider required to respond?

My gym took a much bigger monthly payment than usual by direct debit and I only noticed about six weeks later. Can I still get the money back from my bank even though I signed the direct debit form, how long do I have to ask, and how quickly does the bank have to get back to me?

El recibo mensual del gimnasio me vino mucho más alto de lo normal y no me di cuenta hasta unas seis semanas después. Aunque firmé la domiciliación, ¿puedo pedirle al banco que me devuelva el dinero? ¿Hasta cuándo tengo para reclamarlo y cuánto tiempo tiene el banco para responderme?
